summary.motive: Deploy maximum chaos and bring a 6-man overload house blitz on money downs, using the Peel technique on the edge to eliminate the QB’s hot checkdown.
summary.keyDefender: WDE (Peel defender on RB) & MIKE (Unblocked interior blitzer)
summary.whyItWorks: Offenses rely on the RB flare/flat route to punish all-out blitzes; having the edge rusher peel and convert into man coverage on the RB leaves the QB holding the ball with no protection.
summary.failureMode: Quick back-shoulder fade to an outside WR if the cornerback loses the initial press jam.

beats.title: 7-Man Standing Amoeba Presentation
beats.text: Macdonald walks 7 defenders up to the line in a chaotic Amoeba front, with defenders shifting and pointing to make pass-protection ID impossible.

beats.title: 6-Man Overload & Cover 0 Peel
beats.text: At the snap, 6 rushers ignite! As the RB releases on a hot flare route to beat the blitz, WDE executes a textbook peel technique, sprinting into the flat to take the hot read away.

beats.title: Unblocked A-Gap Destruction
beats.text: With the protection overwhelmed and the hot RB flare completely covered by the peeling WDE, MIKE arrives untouched in the A-gap for an immediate 1.8s sack.

beats.title: Drive-Ending Turnover on Downs
beats.text: All perimeter receivers are locked in aggressive press-man coverage with nowhere for the QB to escape.

relations.tell: All mugged rushers explode forward with no underneath droppers, edge peeling on RB
